$comment: As archive/topic. document { kind: "author", title, href, strapline (the member's role), biography (the member's bio), photo (media id), email, phone, socials ([{ name, url, icon }], as a team card's) } is this case's own shape: an author's page is the team member's own page. First page, so the profile is drawn: portrait (thumb, lazy, in div.salt-archive__portrait), strapline, biography, then the contact and social links as the team card draws them. The phone follows section#display-forms. Two cards, one page: no pagination (route.pagination.total is 1). The listing keeps three-column card sizes (the section's grid is three columns whatever the count).
summary: An author's page, the team member's own, on its first page: the name as h1, the profile with portrait, role, bio, email, phone and a social link, then the listing section with two cards and no pagination.
